passages.title: Digital Identity and Transactional Messages
passages.text: Siska received a message from an account showing her class leader’s profile picture. It asked her to upload the group assignment and share the password to the class folder. Siska noticed that the account name contained an extra letter. She contacted the leader through the official class chat. The leader confirmed that the assignment was due on Friday but said that no one should share folder passwords. Siska then uploaded her work through the school platform and reported the suspicious account.
